newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were steady to higher on Wednesday with the focus on nearby supply and demand, several dealers said.
"Nobody is buying deferreds," a Kansas dealer said.
He noted the recent gains in the Chicago Board of Trade corn futures and high temperatures in parts of Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas were two main features in the market.
There are pockets of dry grass as a result of high temperatures in Texas, Oklahoma and Kansas but there is still plenty of grass for livestock to feed on, the Kansas dealer said.
In Buffalo, continued slow runtimes at some flour mills have supported prices, a dealer in that area said.
The southeastern region remained in the doldrums. There was still a problem of buyers not chasing the market, a North Carolina dealer said.
But in North Texas, nearby business continued to be brisk, a Texas broker said.
